purpose: A personal bilingual Romanian/English recipe collection.
audience: The owner and returning visitors choosing what to cook.

confirmedByUser.goal: Three serious, distinct homepage design proposals to inspect before choosing an implementation.
confirmedByUser.preserve: All existing homepage information and capabilities must remain accessible.
confirmedByUser.cardPrice: A compact money symbol and number representing cost per portion; never long text over photographs.
confirmedByUser.scope: Standalone mockups only; no changes to application source code.

designFreedom: Keep the product name, recipe facts, photography and functionality. Reconsider all composition, typography, spacing, proportions, materials, navigation, control presentation and color. This is a redesign exploration, not incumbent-style refinement.
avoid: fake favorites or accounts presented as existing functionality
three proposals that are merely palette variations
contentContract: Shared catalogue is derived from the current recipe JSON and pricing implementation. Price status must remain discoverable in a tooltip or accessible label; available numeric prices are always per serving. Timing is current source metadata, not a newly verified readiness claim. Label prototypes explicitly.
unresolved: whether any proposed interaction should later replace production behavior
